entries.c41aa8ef03757f7d: Under the corporate philosophy “Challenge the Limits of Productivity” and the group vision “Global Niche Top,” the company transitioned to a pure holding company structure in April 2025. As its medium-term management strategies, the company cites strengthening development and sales capabilities for existing solutions and expanding applicable fields; expanding the smart factory domain centered on production management systems; cloud migration of existing systems and deployment of SaaS/PaaS through a monozukuri DX platform; and advancing business through collaboration with other companies and M&A. It aims to evolve into a “Manufacturing DX Integrator,” with technological innovation as a CAD/CAM maker at its core.
